entities.name: Bacterial RNase E-like protein
observations: The 768-aa query aligns to E. coli RNase E (UniProt P21513) with 91.4% identity over 77.0% of query; sequence evidence strongly supports RNase E-family identity.
Query-derived estimates: 86.9 kDa, theoretical pI 6.61, GRAVY -0.829; long acidic/basic low-complexity C-terminal extension is compositionally distinctive.

entities.name: RNase E P21513
observations: Reviewed E. coli K-12 reference: endoribonuclease involved in RNA processing and decay, including maturation of rRNA and tRNA and degradation of many mRNAs.
E. coli reference annotation reports preference for 5'-monophosphorylated RNA, Mg2+ and Zn2+ association, homotetramerization, and association with the RNA degradosome and cytoplasmic membrane.
